notes: Gas & pressure lantern: Coleman Lantern range became an archetype with model versions from Farm Collector and Terry Marsh; Petromax, Tilley X246 and Vapalux (Willis & Bates models E41/300X/M1/M320 as versions) as archetypes; Primus, Go System, Vango, Gelert kept as flat models. Hurricane lantern: cold/hot-blast/dead-flame moved from models to types; Dietz Junior, Blizzard, D-Lite, Little Wizard, Monarch, Little Giant and Feuerhand Baby as archetypes; Dietz 78 and 90 left as flat models (no page found confirming them). New kind Oil & kerosene lamp: Argand (with Carcel, moderator, astral), Kosmos, Duplex, Aladdin, Tilley TL10, Victorian parlour, Turkish mosaic and Moroccan brass. No oil table lamps were moved from Table lamp (none in this shelf's data). Aladdin model numbers left out (unconfirmed). Candle lantern: UCO models as versions of the Original; gandō as an archetype. UCO introduction year left blank (sources conflict, 1971 vs 1981). Paper lantern: Odawara, Gifu, Suifu chōchin with a chōchin tradition entry. Electric lantern cut from 45 models to 11 (BioLite, Goal Zero, MPOWERD, Black Diamond, Fenix, Streamlight, luminAID, Snow Peak, Coleman); Vulcan range dropped as duty gear. Coleman founding year left blank (not on a retrieved page). gov-online.go.jp and web-japan.org returned 403; not retried.
